dedupe_keys.name: future climate projections of surface weather variables wind power and solar power capacity factors across north west europe

description: The University of Reading provides climate-adjusted hourly weather and renewable generation variables for north-west Europe. Five climate-model simulations supply changes centred on 2035, calculated over 2020–2050, which are applied as delta corrections to a historical ERA5 sequence. The archive includes temperature, wind speed, solar irradiance, heating and cooling degree-days, and onshore wind, offshore wind and solar capacity factors. Country-level series are supplemented by selected regions around Great Britain. The repository lists the underlying sequence as 1950–2020; that period must not be confused with the future climate represented by the corrections. Separate ZIP archives hold the variables, with Python scripts and a README available alongside. Access is open and free under CC-BY-4.0; internal data encodings were not checked. A limitation is that the delta method retains a historical sequence and is not a complete transient future weather simulation. These inputs could test electricity and heating capacity under changed climate conditions, alongside data-era5-reanalysis and observed energy records from data-open-power-system-data.
